title: SKE Crystal Pro Strawberry Burst Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods provide a simple and cost-effective way to enjoy exceptional flavour without the waste of single-use disposables. Each prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid, ensuring a smooth and satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape with rapid nicotine relief. Strawberry Burst captures the bright, sun-ripened sweetness of juicy strawberries, delivering a bold and authentic fruit flavour. The inhale is packed with lush berry notes, while a subtly tangy finish adds depth, making for a smooth and well-rounded vape. Swapping pods is effortless—simply remove the empty pod and insert a fresh one. Whether you're looking for a convenient alternative to disposables or a reliable way to continue enjoying your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods offer a mess-free and flavour-packed vaping experience.
